cs.label: [section] Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy:
cs.content: Cílem předmětu je naučit posluchače poznávat nejvýznamnější škůdce okrasných rostlin, seznámit je se symptomy, které způsobují na hostitelských rostlinách, s morfologií, bionomií, ekologickými nároky a s možnostmi regulace těchto druhů.

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: To obtain elementary knowledge in horticultural entomology and ability to determine insect pests and recommend methods of pest control.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Pest of ornamental plants in greenhouse (symptoms, morphology, bionomics, ecological requirements, pest control) (allowance 4/4) a.Hemiptera (Aleyrodinea, Aphidoidea, Coccoidea)b.Thysanopterac.Dipterad.Lepidopterae.Acarina2.Pests of deciduous trees (symptoms, morphology, bionomics, ecological requirements, pest control) (allowance 8/8) a.Hemiptera (Heteroptera, Auchenorhyncha, Aleyrodinea, Aphidoidea, Coccoidea)b.Coleoptera (phyllophagous, rhizophagous, xylophagous)c.Lepidoptera (phyllophagous, xylophagous, miners)d.Diptera (miners, cecidiophagous)e.Hymenoptera (phyllophagous, miners, cecidiophagous)f.Acarina (Tetranychidae, Eriophyidae)3.Pests of ornamental conifers (symptoms, morphology, bionomics, ecological requirements, pest control) (allowance 6/6) a.Hemiptera (Heteroptera, Aphidoidea, Coccoidea)b.Coleoptera (phyllophagous, xylophagous)c.Lepidoptera (phyllophagous, xylophagous, miners)d.Hymenoptera (phyllophagous, miners)e.Acarina (Tetranychidae)4.Pests of perennial and annual plants (symptoms, morphology, bionomics, ecological requirements, pest control) (allowance 6/6) a.Polyphagous pests of flower (Hemiptera, Coleoptera, Lepidoptera, Diptera)b.Pests of bulb and tuber plantsc.Pests of rosesd.Pests of rock plantse.Pests of aquatic plants
